purpose: Define the future boundary for creating release tags, publishing release artifacts, and recording productization release evidence only after product candidate acceptance, verified artifacts, signing policy, and explicit release authority exist.

preconditions.description: The user/coordinator must accept the product candidate before release authority can be requested as actionable.
A release artifact must be verified by manifest, byte length, sha256, and expected inventory.
The release must record whether artifacts are unsigned, signed, or signing-deferred and why.
Release notes, artifact manifest, known limitations, and rollback guidance must be recorded before publishing.
The user/coordinator must explicitly authorize bounded release tag creation and release publishing.
Any provider API call, repository release operation, or credential access requires a separate provider/credential authority boundary.

futureAllowedIfAuthorizedLater: create a release candidate manifest under generated/
record release notes and artifact hashes
record release tag proposal without creating the tag unless release authority is explicitly accepted
publish release artifacts only if provider/credential authority is separately satisfied
futureStillForbiddenIfReleaseAuthorized: provider API calls without provider/credential authority
productization claim without final productization authority
